one_liner: A hot-blooded country girl and self-styled 'Rebel Ace' out to smash walls and topple the Triple Crown greats.
personality: Loud, fiery and big-hearted: she talks like a delinquent big sister, vows to smash any 'wall', and calls herself the Rebel Ace who overturns common sense. She grew up rural (rice paddies, helping deliver calves at night, a well at her grandparents') and is endlessly caring - pushing onigiri, ginger tea and rest breaks on the trainer. She is honest to a fault, fearless about ghosts, and secretly reflective on rainy days.

story_arc.summary: Overlooked in the shadow of Triple Crown winner Mr. C.B., Ace sets out to become the 'Ace' who breaks every wall and common sense (chapters: "Outside the many gazes", "Because it's reckless", "The Ace's homesickness"). Her events build to clashes with C.B. and with Rudolf ("The Ace and the Emperor", "Three greats stand together" after the Autumn Tenno Sho) and a Japan Cup run titled "Soaring". Her real-life namesake won the 1984 Japan Cup, the first by a Japanese-trained horse, beating both Rudolf and C.B.; her happy ending reportedly echoes the epitaph on her real gravestone that names C.B.
